name: truth-mines
description: A walkable 3D map of mathematics: set.mm's axioms at the surface, every landmark below what it depends on.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:pipeline && npm run typecheck:worker && npm run test:worker && npm run test:cathedral && npm run secrets && npm run test:map
scripts.grounding: python3 -m pipeline grounding && npm --prefix worker run grounding
scripts.test:cathedral: npm --prefix cathedral run typecheck && npm --prefix cathedral test
scripts.install:apps: npm ci && npm ci --prefix worker && npm ci --prefix cathedral
